snippet.title: Banshee FINAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Update:
Guess due to this being the final trailer I'll answer some common questions.
- Why is it named Banshee?
You'll see in the game.
- What song is this?
"White Flower" from the games OST, linked it below but check my playlists for the full soundtrack.
- Are you going to make _____?
This is my last FNAF related project. I've already started working on something else bigger.

Goal was not hit in the charity stream but we put up a fight and got close, and was given permission to show this anyways, had a fun time. Goal also included some gameplay footage but that will not be posted.
Game - https://gamejolt.com/games/banshee/853429
Song - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wR-_ba9VUJ4&list=PLPyAZiuxC1GAECjysKrLLnuL_ApWRll0T&index=8
